method.source: PacSim (MIT), already on this machine, read for structure only: include/sensorModels/sensorBase.hpp, include/VehicleModel/deadTime.hpp, config/sensors.yaml. Nothing copied, nothing downloaded.
method.sampling: a channel samples when time >= its last sample + 1/rate, keeping its own cadence; its clock starts at the first observation
method.delivery: each sample is queued and delivered once its dead time has passed; the newest arrived sample is what is read
method.error: Gaussian, one draw per value, from a per-channel std::mt19937_64 stream derived from the seed and the channel
method.loop: observed at every fixed tick with the plant's true state; nothing reads the measurements, the car drives on its true state
method.recording: schema 14: metadata.sensors (channels, seed, fingerprint), measurements.csv one row per tick, telemetry.csv longitudinal_acceleration_mps2; the loader runs the instruments again from the seed over the recorded states and requires the same stream

lap_dynamic_car_seed_7.same_lap_without_instruments: out/runs/p71-true-lap: telemetry.csv and decisions.csv byte-identical, 33.795 s either way

refusals: measurements.csv x_m nudged by 1 mm: is not what these instruments measure from the recorded seed and states
seed changed 2026 -> 2027: metadata.sensors.fingerprint does not identify the instruments recorded beside it
pose_sampled_at_s later than its tick: is later than the tick that read it
one row missing: one measurement per recorded tick
achieved acceleration +1: is not the speed this sample gained over the tick before it

capture.run: the four-wheel car, 4 s in, instruments fitted

mutation_checks: Five mutations were run and reverted. Delivering a sample before its dead time had passed failed a_sample_arrives_a_dead_time_later and instruments_read_a_run_without_changing_it; sampling at every observation instead of at the channel's rate failed a_channel_samples_at_its_own_rate; writing the true pose into measurements.csv failed measured_run_round_trips; dropping the loader's comparison of the recorded pose with the pose measured again failed rejects_measurement_violations. Giving the speed channel the pose channel's stream first passed every group, because the independence check watched only the steering; a check that no two channels' first errors are alike was added and fails that mutation.
